name: record-page-shell
title: Record page shell
description: The frame for one record, an order, a contact or a ticket: back link, title with status, actions, tabs, and a main column beside a details rail.
docs: Give it backHref (and backLabel, the list's name, which is read as 'Back to Orders'), the record's title (the page's h1; pass titleAs="h2" inside a preview), a status, a meta line, actions, and the two columns: main and rail. tabs, activeTab and onTabChange come as a set: the tabs scroll sideways with faded edges when they do not fit, and the main column is the tab panel of the current one, so put that tab's content in main. rail takes a DescriptionList with layout="stacked" (or anything); it is a labelled aside with railTitle as its heading, sticky from lg and under the main column below it. meta takes one node or a list of nodes set off with dots. The shell renders on the server unless you pass tabs; pass your router's Link as linkAs. It adds its own page padding: pass className="p-0" when your app shell already pads.
